title: Go Car. Go Go Go!
text:
If you don't want to drive and have more than two people in your party request the four seater. It is like a mini cooper-go cart -jeep.
The onboard navigation is informative and entertaining, as if you had a human guide with you. Don't under estimate the power of this little electric engine. when you put your foot on the gas you get to 30kph really quickly.

title: Fun Barcelona Go-Car experience
text: Driving around Barcelona in a Go-Car was so much fun. The vehicle actually spoke to us, guiding us turn by turn while sharing interesting information about the city and its attractions. It was like having our own personnel tour guide! We did go off course a couple of times, but it was easy to get back on track. It was a fun and different way to explore Barcelona, and we would definitely recommend it!
author: Brian_S

author: 353leeannew

title: An awesome and fun and economical way to tour Barcelona.....
text: What an awesome and unique way to tour Barcelona - we had so much fun and doing it at our own pace and this was the highlight of our stay. Car was super easy to drive, lots of power and easy to park and get around. And the GPS tour guide was perfect. We took the extra hour recommendation to allow us to grab lunch and take a little longer. For anyone going Barcelona this has to be part of your trip!

title: This is a super fun way...
text: This is a super fun way to explore Barcelona, thought it would feel a bit more intimidating driving in normal traffic, but it wasn’t bad at all. Through the city it is a bit of a challenge finding a spot to park if you want to explore, but it’s still a fun experience!
author: Reuben_B

title: Unique experience
text:
What a cool experience. One of a kind and original idea. We managed to see the whole of Barcelona in like 3 hours. It was great to see different areas and take in the Spanish atmosphere without constantly having to walk around. 
One thing that was slightly frustrating was the lack of parking option so we couldn’t always stop and get a drink or explore and had to keep going which was a shame.

author: S1057MObriank

title: Great Staff. Car easy to operate
text:
We had such a great experience with GoCar! The staff were incredibly accommodating from the moment we arrived—they made everything easy, answered all our questions, and got us set up quickly without any hassle.
The driving experience itself was much easier than I expected. The car was simple to operate, and the directions and guidance made navigating the city feel smooth and stress-free, even for first-timers.
What really stood out was how much my daughter enjoyed it. She said it was the best part of our entire trip, which says a lot! It turned out to be such a fun and memorable way to explore
